sloka: गुहो ज्ञातिसहस्रेण शरचापासिधारिणा।समन्वेषतु काकुत्स्थावस्मिन् परिवृत: स्वयम् ॥ २.९८.४॥
transliteration: guho jñātisahasreṇa śaracāpāsidhāriṇā।samanveṣatu kākutsthāvasmin parivṛta: svayam ॥ 2.98.4॥

translations.english: Let Guha, surrounded by a thousand kinsmen and armed with bows, arrows and swords look for Rama.
